neighbours.label: a token in text about Turkish or Ottoman politics and institutions (Tanzimat, Medeniyetleri, Mehmet, vatan)
fire: The Young Turks attacked the Tanzimat reforms, stressing the nation (millet).
Anadolu Medeniyetleri Müzesi was opened in 1921.
The head of the agency, Mehmet Ali, gave a speech.
Ottoman liberals wrote on patriotism and fatherland (vatan) at length.
Ege Medeniyetleri Merkezi was founded in Izmir.
The governor, Mehmet Emin, visited the town.
Reformers in Istanbul debated the Tanzimat decrees and freedom (hürriyet).
Türk Medeniyetleri Enstitüsü published a new book.
quiet: The Young Hegelians attacked the Prussian reforms, stressing the nation in general.
The National Museum of Art was opened in 1921.
The head of the agency, Mark Allen, gave a speech.
French liberals wrote on patriotism and fatherland at length.
The Art Institute was founded in Chicago.
The governor, Mark Evans, visited the town.
Reformers in Paris debated the royal decrees and freedom.

notes: Card: ' Meh' x2, 'ما' x2, '1' x2, ' (', ' Y', 'et'. Probes: ' (' before vatan 0.795, 'et' in Medeniyetleri 0.573, ' Meh' 0.247, Erdogan 0.083; parallel sentences 0.05. So peaks are on varied tokens and the median may be low.
